facts.text: Université de Sherbrooke again ranks among the 15 best employers in Canada.
In 2025, investments in Sherbrooke's clean technologies sector rose 62% to $63.7 million, while quantum technologies investments reached $9 million, up 90%.
Université de Sherbrooke has 31,000 students and Bishop's University 2,867; with about 40,000 students in total, nearly one in four Sherbrooke residents is a student.
The CIUSSS de l'Estrie - CHUS, headquartered in Sherbrooke, is the largest employer in the Estrie region.

overview: Sherbrooke had 172,950 residents at the 2021 Census, up 7.2 percent from 161,323 in 2016, one of the stronger growth rates among Quebec's larger cities. Those residents occupy 80,476 private dwellings spread over 353.4 square kilometres, so the customer base is spread across distinct districts rather than one core.

The city runs on institutions. Université de Sherbrooke and Bishop's University bring tens of thousands of students each year, and the regional health authority is the largest employer in Estrie. A local business gains from a young, renewing customer pool and from steady institutional demand that does not swing with the seasons.

byService.lead-generation: Because the population of 172,950 is spread over 353.4 square kilometres, Sherbrooke lead generation works best with district-level targeting and offers timed to the university calendar.
byService.seo: Sherbrooke searches are overwhelmingly in French, so ranking depends on French keyword research, local citations in Estrie directories and pages for each borough from Fleurimont to Rock Forest.
byService.website-development: A Sherbrooke website should be mobile first and bilingual where students matter, since roughly one in four residents is a student and most compare local services on a phone.
byService.branding: With a growing city of more than 172,000 people anchored by universities and hospitals, Sherbrooke branding should signal expertise and stability to institutional buyers while staying approachable for students.
